title: Arsène
author: Lionel Le Boiteux

success_metrics.name: time from draft start to published
success_metrics.baseline: approximately 50 minutes (self-reported estimate, not yet precisely measured)

counter_metric: writer adoption must not decline - writers reverting to drafting in Word or Google Docs and manually pasting is a failure signal even if the time metric improves
out_of_scope: ads/monetisation integration, Wix content migration, affiliate/sponsored content blocks, human editorial approval workflow
